refactor(psc0): migrate finite worker families under selected R [sh1-qualify]

Replace twelve selected higher-order worker adapters with ordinary state parameters and remove three scoped projection aliases. Preserve public curried types, parameter order, structural recursion, fuel and error behavior.

Check independent and paired R/F behavior, actual public Core types and ordered IR signatures in the existing qualification. Enforce the new-only PS grammar in reusable preparation sessions and retain exact provider receipt bytes. Keep R selected and qualify F without another successor promotion.
